limits: Arrivals, pull latency (zero), and information costs are simulated.
The new datasets broaden equipment/geography within energy, not all industrial domains.
Each dataset is trained separately; not zero-shot transfer.
Only 4.5 months of Appliances data: final-test block interval has limited power.
value_features removes arrival metadata from added features, retaining the original calibrated backbone.
Legacy bundle fitting also generates its old test report automatically; protocol and candidate family were frozen beforehand, and candidate selection never reads that report.
Oracle headroom is an unachievable hindsight diagnostic, not policy quality.

reasons: Appliances/mixed_2811/validation_simple: confidence interval does not establish improvement

Appliances/outage_2811/validation_simple: confidence interval does not establish improvement

promotion_gate.scope: all predeclared new-dataset conditions; not universal superiority

policy.augmentation: one independently sampled acquired subset per policy origin and wait; probability uniform in [0,1]; plus empty subset

preprocessing.hourly: right-closed, right-labeled mean of six 10-minute observations; remove incomplete edge bins only; reject interior gaps

rules: Freeze this protocol before new-dataset performance is inspected; do not revise after final evaluation.
Fit forecasters on train; fit action labels on policy; choose candidates and margins on validation only.
Include forecast-only, policy-only, combined, and arrival-metadata ablations; promotion refers only to the predeclared combined method.
Apply the same origin, target, decision grid, and per-sensor acquisition costs to every sequential method.
Every method may acquire each currently unavailable origin-slot sensor once; acquisitions persist across waits; stop at deadline.
Oracle is retrospective headroom only and never a deployable competitor.
All datasets train separately; results are not zero-shot transfer or universal superiority.
All arrival timestamps and information costs are simulated. No measured deployment savings claim.
If the gate fails retain the production model, report failure, and do not retune on newly exposed tests.
